id: title:a-lider:run team digests and achievements without a user

review.posthog_relevance: Supports warehouse ingestion and scheduled reporting workflows by allowing warehouse access control bypass for team-scoped, user-less operations, while retaining access boundaries for user-facing queries.
review.reason: The change adds a warehouse access control bypass parameter to HogQL query execution and scheduled digest jobs. This allows warehouse-joined filters to succeed without a user context, preventing false failures for warehouse ingestion and scheduled reports. The implementation is bounded to warehouse access control and query execution, with no broader systemic changes.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on warehouse access control configuration and warehouse-joined filter usage, which are not independently verified. The score does not account for adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and test-only changes. No score is assigned.
